svg.aria-label: About me. Third-year Electrical and Electronic Engineering undergraduate at the University of Peradeniya, Sri Lanka, building systems end to end. Now building FloodLink, a flood early-warning system for the Mahaweli River. Also building FlyMe, RC aircraft telemetry and a ground station. Exploring river-level forecasting with classical ML and neural networks. 2nd Place, Idea to Invention 2025. EngEx 2025 Media Lead, drone pilot, photographer and astronomy enthusiast. IEEE PES and IEEE MTT-S member, former President of the Buddhist Society (FoE).
svg.text: I build systems end to end.
